purpose: PR #31 benchmark summary; raw captures are local.

configuration.order: ABBA x3 per scenario (baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline repeated three times)
configuration.build_targets: separate Cargo target directories, binary reorder symbols validated before measurement
configuration.cpu_scope: whole benchmark child process, including both transports and proxy

scenarios.loss: Drop first transmission of sequence 10 and each sequence congruent to 7 modulo 20 (27 packets of 512).
scenarios.reorder: Forward sequence 11 and its datagram before sequence 10, then send sequence 10 after a 10 ms delay.
scenarios.nofault: No proxy fault; concurrent receiver workers can still process datagrams out of order.

limits: Single host/process, small 16-byte control payloads; not a voice capacity or many-peer test.
Six observations per revision per scenario; medians/ranges are descriptive, not significance estimates.
CPU and RSS include benchmark process and measurement wrapper.

historical_voice_benchmarks.finding: Both large voice cases failed stated capacity screens; 100% case stopped at the 24 GiB working-set limit.
historical_voice_benchmarks.limitations: Single run per condition, shared Windows loopback host; no repeat-based confidence estimate.

historical_voice_benchmarks.finding: Unbounded dispatcher-task backlog caused memory growth; the admission probe bounded tasks but saturated ingress.
historical_voice_benchmarks.limitations: One run per condition; local Windows loopback; diagnostic causal study.

key_results.probe_interpretation: The queue reached its configured capacity; bounded task allocation came with ingress saturation, not equal-work capacity evidence.

historical_voice_benchmarks.finding: 10% candidate passed validation; 100% case failed stale-avatar validation.
historical_voice_benchmarks.limitations: Historical frozen builds; not validation of PR head.

historical_voice_benchmarks.finding: C# cases failed capacity; source cadence differed sharply between all-speaking Rust and C# runs.
historical_voice_benchmarks.limitations: Single runs; differing offered rates limit all-speaking comparison.

provenance.voice_archived_summaries: captures/pr31-results-history-cleanup-20261008/results/ (five JSON files; four referenced above plus reliable-receive-20261008.json)
provenance.raw_captures: Raw captures are local and ignored by Git; no raw logs or audio are included.

peer_snapshot_microbenchmark.equal_work_assertion: All strategies visit identical active work on each pass.
peer_snapshot_microbenchmark.sample_columns: Within each case, one six-value nanosecond array per strategy in strategy order.
limits: Enumeration microbenchmark only: no socket sends, callbacks, per-peer dispatch locks, or whole-server load or application latency.
One run with six samples per case/strategy; no independent repeat.
main_like_guard_scan omits callbacks and is not a full main dispatch-path reproduction.
Fresh Vec counts are instances created, not allocator malloc calls.
No whole-server speedup claim is supported.

voice_test_configuration.applies_to: Dense 1,000-client capacity/dedicated comparisons; memory report includes 250-client diagnostics.
voice_test_configuration.topology: Windows UDP loopback; clients colocated and within hearing range; P2P disabled.
voice_test_configuration.host: Windows 11 build 26100, AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, 16 logical processors.
voice_test_configuration.audio: 40 local music clips (not recorded conversations), encoded as 48 kHz mono Opus, 20 ms frames, 32 kbit/s target.
voice_test_configuration.avatar_traffic: All clients sent avatar poses/deltas; CPU-only fixture.
voice_test_configuration.verification: Host/workload details checked against report prose and archive configs; manifest hashes match in Rust/C# summaries.

Shutdown closes both lifecycle queues, skips new connection requests, drains committed disconnect events and joins all handlers before final persistence.

Shutdown closes disconnect ingress while both cleanup callbacks are held, then drains the buffered third disconnect after release.
Retired ordered lane preserves its running head/new generation; repeated retirement compacts stale ready keys.
limitations: Four samples per revision/configuration on one shared host; descriptive medians without statistical significance established.
